# /etc/systemd/system/davinci-gpu-arbiter.timer
[Unit]
Description=DaVinci render performance and GPU arbitration

[Timer]
OnBootSec=20s
OnUnitActiveSec=5s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=davinci-gpu-arbiter.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
reason: Same GPU arbiter logic every10sec retains short render priority/recovery but halves idle systemd process starts; no GPU service freeze or LXC shutdown
rollback: rm /etc/systemd/system/davinci-gpu-arbiter.timer.d/90-cloud9-low-overhead.conf; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart davinci-gpu-arbiter.timer
